title: CDC - Preventing Chronic Disease: E-mail Privacy Policy
content: E-mail Privacy Policy Print Minus Related Pages We are committed to keeping your e-mail address confidential. We do not sell, rent, or lease our subscription lists to third parties, and we will not provide your personal information to any third party individual, government agency, or company at any time. We will use your e-mail address solely to communicate Preventing Chronic Disease information. The CDC will maintain the information you send via e-mail in accordance with applicable federal law. If you have any additional questions, please refer to the CDC Privacy Policy or contact us at pcdeditor@cdc.gov . The opinions expressed by authors contributing to this journal do not necessarily reflect the opinions of the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services, the Public Health Service, the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, or the authors’ affiliated institutions. Last Reviewed: March 27, 2015 Source: National Center for Chronic Disease Prevention and Health Promotion
